_about: MSMA 2nd Edition (DID Malaysia, 2012), Chapter 2 Quantity Design Fundamentals, Table 2.B1: IDF fitting constants for the Selangor raingauges (ARI 2-100 yr, durations 5 min-72 h). Read from the page image of the official PDF (page 2-27) on 22 Oct 2026; the 2913001 and 2815001 rows match the values already sourced on 21 Oct (research/HY_screening_inputs.md). Positions: JPS Selangor's own rainfall-station layer (jpsselgis.selangor.gov.my, Hosted/Stesen_Hidrologi, layer 2 'Stesen Rain Fall (RF)'), matched by name on 22 Oct 2026; every match agrees with the station-number grid (first two digits = latitude x 10, next two = longitude - 100, x 10). Where JPS's name differs from MSMA's, the position is the nearest JPS telemetry station of that town and is marked L.
